{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to numeric
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
